title: Stand Up For Your Rights: The Fight Against Jew Hatred

chapters.title: Introduction to the SCA and Brook Goldstein
chapters.about: Michael Mishaan introduces the Sephardic Community Alliance and Brook Goldstein.

chapters.title: The Lawfare Project and Civil Rights
chapters.about: Brook Goldstein explains the use of impact litigation to protect Jewish communities.

chapters.title: The Importance of Jewish Unity
chapters.about: The need for a unified, non-partisan approach to fighting Jew hatred.

chapters.title: Focusing on CUNY
chapters.about: Addressing systemic bigotry at the City University of New York.

chapters.title: The End Jew Hatred Movement
chapters.about: Defining the movement as a grassroots idea for all Jews.

chapters.title: Grassroots Success Stories
chapters.about: Examples of mobilization in Berlin and the power of local chapters.

chapters.title: Brook Goldstein's Background
chapters.about: Her transition from entertainment law to human rights advocacy.

summary: Michael Mishaan and Brook Goldstein discuss the rise of Jew hatred and the necessity for the Jewish community to unite across partisan and religious lines to address this as a civil rights issue. They emphasize the importance of grassroots mobilization and impact litigation to ensure consequences for discrimination, highlighting the End Jew Hatred movement as a collective effort for Jewish liberation.
subjects: Title VI of the Civil Rights Act
questions: Why is Jew hatred still socially acceptable on college campuses?
How can the Jewish community use civil rights litigation to protect itself?
What is the role of grassroots mobilization in fighting discrimination?
Why is it important for the Jewish community to remain unified across partisan lines?
How can we demand allyship from other communities?
